Implementation progress from fresh main5db2761590dd824fa159625326b6eaf3923b999a, branch feature/entropy-warm-prerequisites.

Independent design v2 review4ea0af412443a25f1b5679dc078679b3f99df36772d9a475b09a0859e971bdcd found34 source/contract inputs unchanged and accepted bounded design principles, with zero tests. Both final clarifications are in this issue: one old4MiB raw group plus one active4MiB group (not an RSS claim), and an eligible postbinding creation hook whose individual crossed/unqualified runs may remain unsealed.

Production ownership is limited to account_scope.rs and execution_scope.rs. A separate test author froze a new normal HTTP/WS module with16 async functions/37 source-expanded cases; no compilation/execution is claimed. Root froze explicit adaptations to existing64 warm scenarios: immutable original verification time plus real new financial receipt, source-derived44/82/84 request minima, genuine original2s expiry/fresh applied WS for four future-HTTP faults, and preserved new-raw lower bounds with separate original-prerequisite raw checks. Business fill/fee/Cache/Portfolio/reserve/refusal assertions remain.

The quota negative's former two full preloads no longer produces equivalent demand under reuse. Its candidate now requires three actual successful complete full262 groups before a fourth full target, unchanged3s deadline/1200-per-minute/20-per-second supply and a <=10s fixture setup bound. Actual early TTL refusal, missing source receipt or a slow setup will be a fixture FAIL, not quota coverage. This source-derived feasibility argument is not a measured bucket balance or a test PASS.

Source review and actual native tests/build/stubs/installed/application scenarios remain pending. Prior115 corrected paired failure, raw evidence and immutable Unknown debt remain unchanged; no repeat of that failed candidate is being used to manufacture success.
